title: spec: declare `viewMode` on `GanttConfigSchema` — the contract half of objectui#5074's ruled both-branches wiring
body:
Filed by the triage seat as the spec half of the objectui#5074 ruling (maintainer, 2026-08-18, verbatim 「同意」: declare `viewMode` and wire BOTH branches — the half-wired state, effective only under `resourceView`, is the worst of the three options).

## Scope

Add a `viewMode` enum to `GanttConfigSchema` in `packages/spec` (the `gantt` block vocabulary — currently 17 keys, `viewMode` absent), with the docs/authorable-surface/pin artifacts spec-surface conventions require.

**Enum members come from measurement, not invention**: read `GanttView`'s actually supported granularities in objectui (`packages/plugin-gantt/src/GanttView.tsx` — its `viewMode` component prop and defaults) before fixing the member list; declare exactly what the renderer honors, nothing speculative.

## Constraints

- **Clause-②: yes** — this widens the accept set (a new authorable key); contract-review tier dispatch, claim carries `Clause-②: yes`.
- Type is Feature by the mechanical boundary test (expands the accepted vocabulary), per the ruling's explicit authorization.
- Downstream: **objectui#5074** (`pm:blocked` on this card) declares it on `ObjectGanttSchema` and wires the timeline branch, retiring the `(schema as any).viewMode` cast. After this lands, post the landing on objectui#5074 so its unlock scan fires.
- The gantt component's other undeclared `as any` reads (`readOnly`, `markers`, `holidays`, …) are ⛔ out of scope — they belong to objectui#5043's family track.

Refs: objectui#5074 (the ruling record and the measured half-wiring) · objectui#5057 (the README half that depends on this outcome) · objectui#5043 (the index-signature/passthrough root cause).

Filed by triage session `session_pm_triage_20260818T0104Z`; ruling provenance on objectui#5074.
